title: 300 BJP, Hindu outfit members booked over Thiruparankundram Deepam protests

ai.summary: Protests in Tamil Nadu over failure to light Karthigai Deepam at Deepathoon stone pillar as per Supreme Court order, with police registering cases against 300 BJP and Hindu organisations members.

facts.quote: Cases have been registered against around 300 members of the BJP and Hindu organisations for protesting in Tamil Nadu's Thiruparankundram on Tuesday over the non-lighting of the Karthigai Deepam at the Deepathoon stone pillar
The Supreme Court had directed that the lamp be lit at 6pm.

facts.claim: Lamp lit at Uchi Pillayar temple
facts.quote: The Maha Deepam was instead lit above the Uchi Pillayar temple at Thiruparankundram Hills as part of the annual festival

facts.claim: Police registered cases under six sections
facts.quote: According to the police, cases have been registered under six sections, including unlawful assembly without permission, causing a breach of public peace, making controversial remarks and obstructing government servants from discharging their duties.

ai.background_note: Tamil Nadu government failed to light Karthigai Deepam at Deepathoon stone pillar as per Supreme Court's interim order, leading to protests and police action.
